notice: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA. Ground truth for a fictional letter written for evaluation only. Not a real document; all personal data is invented. 'Muster BKK' is a fictional insurer.

summary_points.en: Your health insurer has not received your enrolment for winter semester 2026/27 and needs a current enrolment certificate.
summary_points.tr: Sağlık sigortan 2026/27 kış dönemi kaydını almamış ve güncel bir öğrenci belgesi istiyor.
summary_points.source_quote: Für das Wintersemester 2026/27 liegt uns jedoch noch keine Meldung vor.

summary_points.en: Without proof, your student insurance may end on 30 September 2026 and you would continue as a voluntary member, which is usually much more expensive.
summary_points.tr: Belge gönderilmezse öğrenci sigortan 30 Eylül 2026'da bitebilir ve gönüllü üye olarak devam edersin; bu genellikle çok daha pahalıdır.
summary_points.source_quote: Der Beitrag für die freiwillige Versicherung ist in der Regel deutlich höher als der Studentenbeitrag.

summary_points.en: There are 142.65 euros of unpaid contributions for August 2026.
summary_points.tr: Ağustos 2026 için 142,65 euro ödenmemiş prim borcu var.
summary_points.source_quote: Außerdem besteht für den Monat August 2026 ein Beitragsrückstand von 142,65 Euro.

deadlines.source_quote: Bitte reichen Sie uns bis spätestens 31.10.2026 eine aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung ein.

deadlines.rule: Within 14 days after receiving the letter.
deadlines.uncertainty_reason: Depends on the date the letter was received, which the app does not know. The app may suggest a date only if the user enters the receipt date, and must label it as an estimate.
deadlines.source_quote: Bitte überweisen Sie diesen Betrag innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Erhalt dieses Schreibens.

description.en: Send a current enrolment certificate by 31 October 2026, via the insurer's app or by post.
description.tr: 31 Ekim 2026'ya kadar güncel öğrenci belgesini sigortanın uygulamasından ya da posta ile gönder.

actions.source_quote: Sie können diese über die Muster BKK App hochladen oder per Post an die oben genannte Adresse senden.

description.en: Transfer the 142.65 euros of unpaid contributions within 14 days of receiving the letter.
description.tr: Mektubu aldıktan sonraki 14 gün içinde 142,65 euro prim borcunu havale et.

actions.source_quote: Bitte überweisen Sie diesen Betrag innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Erhalt dieses Schreibens.

condition.en: If you have finished or interrupted your studies

actions.source_quote: Wenn Sie Ihr Studium beendet oder unterbrochen haben, teilen Sie uns dies bitte umgehend mit.

non_deadline_dates.reason: Possible end of student insurance (a consequence, not a deadline for the user).
Possible start of voluntary insurance (a consequence, not a deadline for the user).
non_deadline_dates.source_quote: ab dem 01.10.2026 als freiwilliges Mitglied weiterversichert

eval_notes: Tests distractor dates (30.09 and 01.10 are consequences, not deadlines) and a relative deadline based on the receipt date. The payment and the enrolment certificate are two separate actions.
